title: Spanish Gold Paper Towel Holder - 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Paper Towel Valet (5 X 14 X 5), Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Spanish Gold, stop chasing a flimsy roll holder around the counter—this freestanding paper towel valet stays put with a weighted base, and it’s available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes to match your kitchen, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished kitchens.

  • Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
  • Protect your surfaces—felt pad helps prevent scratches on countertops
  • Get a clean, modern look that complements contemporary, minimalist kitchens
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives for everyday use

Specs

  • Product type: Countertop paper towel holder / paper towel valet
  • Mounting: Freestanding
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 5 in x 14 in x 5 in
  • Product weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included items: Paper towel holder
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your kitchen with matching pieces by choosing coordinating accessories in the same finish.
meta_description: 14-inch freestanding solid brass paper towel holder for kitchen countertops with a weighted base and felt pad. Available in lifetime designer finishes.
